description: Check catalogue data coverage across published products, collections, pages and articles: taxonomy, SEO fields, product type, vendor, description, images, alt text and optionally GTIN and MPN. Without `type`, totals and per-field coverage; with `type`, the items missing fields, a page at a time. The first call scans the live catalogue and can return status "scanning". Results are kept for an hour.

includeProductIdentifiers.description: Also check GTIN/barcode and MPN on products. A separate, slower scan.

missing.description: With type: only items missing this field, named as in the summary, e.g. "Meta description".

refresh.description: Rescan instead of reusing this hour’s result. Only after the merchant changed catalogue data.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

type.description: List this type’s offenders instead of the summary.

name: check_catalog_data
title: Check catalogue data
